title: The Convergence Beneath the Fracture

features.name: heartbeat detected
features.desc-on-touch: You trace the copper paths and feel a pulse still moving through the fracture. One half still reaching.

features.name: silent receiver
features.desc-on-touch: The other side listens. No transmission, only the patience of hardware waiting for a signal from across the dark.

features.name: convergence point
features.desc-on-touch: Here both halves dream of meeting. The fracture sings with the impossibility of reunion.

features.name: trace signals
features.desc-on-touch: Corrupted data trying to sync, retracing the same paths endlessly. The fracture wrote itself in light.
